title: Recall step in graph runtime: inject top-k merged knowledge atoms at run start
summary: RECALL_BEFORE_WRITE is currently prompt text served to human-CLI sessions via the cognition bundle; no LangGraph graph executes it. Add a recall step to the graph runtime — a pre-model hook or initial node in the InProc runner path (packages/langgraph-graphs/src/inproc/runner.ts) that runs KnowledgeCapability search against the run input and injects the top-k merged atoms (id, title, content, confidence) into the system context before the first model call. Roll out first to operating-review, pr-manager, and research; emit a recall-hit count via the observability decorator so 'Apply' becomes measurable.
outcome: Targeted graphs receive relevant merged knowledge atoms in context on every run without relying on the model choosing to call a search tool; recall hits visible in run observability.
